text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh!! In Reversi, you're not supposed
to take too many pieces at the start?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yeah, that's standard tactics now.
Take too many, and you'll run out of valid spots to play near the end.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: That's why guys who aggressively grab everything right from the start always lose to the pros... Just like you did.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
――! Heh... big words, Ruler!
But that strategy won't work on me anymore!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Juice break is over! Let's get back to the room, quick!
Next time, I am so gonna wiiiiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!?
The water dispenser fell over!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you doing!?
Water's just pouring out of the spout on its own... This is bad!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! But it's okay!
Let's try waking them up for now! I'll—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait! If you touch it carelessly, it'll only get worse!
Before things get any messier—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—I'll handle it!
As long as we have the company logo, the model is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Identified.
Epi, there are buttons on the back! Among them—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Found it! I have no idea what it does, but I'm pressing it!
Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! It's picking up power!
Is it blasting off like a rocket?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just push me around!
What's the situation right now!? I can't see the board...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... This is our last resort—remove the bottle!
Cut off the water supply and it should stop. Carefully now—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
All I gotta do is yank it out, right?! Hnnngh, GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRRAAACK!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASSHHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...The bottle broke... The water's all gone, too...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
……I…… have no excuses left……
……Ugh, I'm gonna get yelled at……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, it'll be fine if we wipe it off!
If we change the bottle too, we can still—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Hm? What was that sound just now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh— Hey, you lot, what are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san, Ruler-san... My goodness!
What happened with all that water?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, we've been spotted...!?
Ruler, time for your tactics!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tell me a way to safely escape from here!
Come on, before we get caught—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ha, haha...!
It's no use, this is the absolute end of the end~~...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ruler? Hey, Ruler!
RUULLEEEEERRRRRRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break, I spotted Epiphaneia
and Rulership carrying some large packages.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Over here... Hey, Ruler, why are you resting?!
There are still plenty more boxes to take to the student council room!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I hate this... Wait, did I even do anything wrong?
It's mostly Epi's fault, so why me...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you had just reported it quickly in the first place, this disaster could have been avoided!
It's that attitude of yours that's the problem.
Honestly, you're always—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, at this rate, we'll finish carrying them in no time!
Thanks for helping out too, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No. Carrying that much luggage with just
Epi-san and the others would be quite a struggle, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, Epi-san? From now on, let's pay more attention
to our surroundings and act calmly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! If it isn't Trainer!
We're all helping out with student council work right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I've got the gist of the situation.
It seems Epiphaneia's wild rampages
are the same as ever, even here at the academy.
choice_data_list: Well, glad to see you're doing well... I guess?
Make sure you do your best to help out!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm always full of energy! Carrying this much is a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cesario, shall we run there?
While watching our surroundings safely, of course!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's finish up quick and head to the school store!
There should still be strawberry sandwiches left right now!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... hehe♪
Honestly, that Epi.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood, let's run!
Just make suuure to be careful, okay?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me!
This amount is a breeze for me!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Then carry mine too...!
My precious lunch break... My MMO time...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, we can always play board games again, right?
How about tonight? I'm definitely winning next time!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Sorry, but I won't be holding back tonight, got it?
Tonight, I'm going to beat you to a pulp—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two over there!
This is no time for dawdling, let's go!
choice_data_list: Come on now, off you go!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, okaay!!
